page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 96 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, providing 96 vCPUs. The processor operates at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The server does not feature any GPU acceleration, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. The lack of hyperthreading ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU, which minimizes noisy-neighbor effects and provides predictable compute performance, though it limits concurrent thread density compared to hyperthreaded configurations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr7.24xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads that require dedicated, non-shared physical CPU resources. The combination of a 3.3 GHz clock speed and 768.0 GB of RAM makes this server type highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
